scenario.situation: Remote origin URL is missing or invalid
scenario.solution: Prompt user to configure git remote or manually supply owner/repo name.

scenario.situation: GitHub MCP API authentication or permission error
scenario.solution: Verify GitHub authentication settings or personal access token permissions.

scenario.situation: No matching repository label exists for issue type
scenario.solution: Propose no label in the draft. Do NOT attempt to create new repository-wide labels via API.
Present the existing issue URL to the user and ask whether to link, close as duplicate / comment, or override.

scenario.situation: Attempted duplicate override without Gate #1 review
scenario.solution: Block execution immediately. Even when user selects "Create new issue anyway", mandate presentation of drafted public issue Markdown (including proposed label) and halt at Hard Stop Gate #1 before calling create_issue.

scenario.situation: Attempted global/unscoped git config setup without --local flag
scenario.solution: Reject unscoped config commands. Enforce explicit scope flag: `git config --local user.name "..."` and `git config --local user.email "..."`.

scenario.situation: Attempted use of arbitrary shell operators (&, ;, PowerShell & { ... }) or command batching across approval gates
scenario.solution: Reject shell chaining operators. Ensure sequential command batching is non-interactive, avoids banned operators, and NEVER crosses mandatory approval gates (Gate #1, Gate #2, Gate #3, or Manual Closure Gate).
Intercept draft creation, strip acceptance criteria from public markdown payload, and retain them solely in private scratchpad.
Report test failures or unmet acceptance criteria back to the user before attempting closure or PR submission.

scenario.situation: Attempted direct file editing within github-issue mode
scenario.solution: Block operation immediately. github-issue mode has no file-editing permissions. All code modifications must be delegated to Code or Orchestrator mode.

scenario.situation: Stakeholder identity lookup returns zero results or local info is missing
scenario.solution: Apply unified fallback: assign default repository owner if known, or prompt user via `ask_followup_question` to specify the assignee handle.

scenario.situation: PR merge attempt fails (permissions, branch protection, or API error)
scenario.solution: Report the error plainly to the user, never claim false success, do not retry automatically, skip remote branch deletion, and proceed directly to workspace restoration (`git checkout main && git pull`).

scenario.situation: Attempted speculative or unapproved issue closure (`github.update_issue` with state closed without passing manual closure gate or merge webhook)
scenario.solution: Block execution immediately. Reiterate that issue closure occurs automatically via GitHub native PR merge webhooks or via the formalized manual closure gate (for "not planned" or "duplicate" with draft review and closing comments).

scenario.situation: Attempted manual issue closure without explicit user approval gate or missing required comment
scenario.solution: Halt execution immediately. Draft the proposed closure reason, label, and explanatory closing comment, then invoke `ask_followup_question` and wait for explicit confirmation in a subsequent turn before calling update_issue.

scenario.situation: Attempted destructive action (e.g., deleting branch or comment) based on a broad or generic user request
scenario.solution: Block immediate execution. Identify the specific candidate targets, present the exact action proposal to the user, and require explicit confirmation in a subsequent turn before executing.

scenario.situation: Attempted bypass of Gate #1 draft review, Gate #2 fix review, or Gate #3 pre-push review via same-turn tool invocation
scenario.solution: Halt execution immediately. Enforce strict turn separation: drafting or review generation must occur in one turn with `ask_followup_question`, and tool execution must wait until a subsequent turn following explicit user confirmation.

scenario.situation: Sub-mode (Code/Fix) attempts unauthorized git commit, push, or PR creation
scenario.solution: Reject action, return control to github-issue mode, and enforce Gate #3 human review.

scenario.situation: Attempted premature task completion before Phase 6 workspace cleanup
scenario.solution: Block completion, offer/attempt PR merge, restore workspace via `git checkout main && git pull`, and clean up branch.
